phase_title: Independent Calibration & Generalization Validation Data Audit
objective: Determine whether independent calibration data exists to validate the frozen predicted_count > 400 router, particularly in the 300-500 colony range.
decision_summary: OUTCOME B — No suitable independent data EXISTS in the repository.

ml-data/colony-dataset/processed_yolo/im.role: Training set for YOLO11n production detector and Phase 5I segmentation model
Validation set used in Phase 5H, 5I, 5J, 5K, 5L for benchmark and threshold selection
Protected test set held out strictly for final production gating

ml-data/colony-segmentation-phase5i/imag.role: Direct mirror of processed_yolo train for segmentation model training
Direct mirror of processed_yolo val for segmentation validation

ml-data/colony-segmentation-poc/images/v.role: Phase 5H MobileSAM POC subset of validation images

training_set.reason: Direct training leakage; models were fitted on these images.

validation_set.reason: Re-evaluation prohibited; candidate rule was discovered and optimized on this split in Phase 5K/5L.

protected_test_set.reason: Quarantined for final blind production sign-off. Prohibited from intermediate calibration tuning.

auxiliary_directories.reason: All auxiliary image directories (high_density_eval_samples, phase5h_eval_samples, etc.) are exact subsets or mirrors of train/val.

missing_data_requirements.required_domain: Independent bacterial Petri-dish colony images collected under distinct laboratory culture and imaging protocols.
missing_data_requirements.target_density_regime: Plates with true colony counts spanning 300 to 500 colonies, specifically targeting the 325-487 void identified in Phase 5L.
missing_data_requirements.annotation_standard: Verified ground-truth point coordinates or bounding boxes annotated by certified microbiologists.
missing_data_requirements.sample_size_target: Minimum N >= 30 plates in the 300-500 density transition zone to achieve statistical power.

scientific_integrity_conclusion: Phase 5M cannot legitimately declare universal router generalization or production deployment readiness without true out-of-distribution calibration data. Fabricating synthetic data or leaking the protected test set is strictly rejected.
